info.title: Tempera Risk API
info.description: Tenant-scoped deterministic risk decisioning and governed non-decisional research. LLMs are not called in the online decision path. Requests and responses are lowerCamelCase JSON; errors are the AIP-193 google.rpc.Status envelope. The graph-read execution response is emitted verbatim because it restates a Tempera Graph signed attestation.

post.summary: Execute one principal-bound, signed, bounded graph read
post.description: Issues and consumes a one-use Risk mandate, calls the separately authenticated Tempera Graph service, verifies the complete signed response, and records paired receipts. The result is non-decisional. This operation mutates replay and audit state and is therefore not declared read-only to MCP clients.

200.description: Verified non-decisional graph result with signed mandate and paired receipts

post.summary: Register an immutable model artifact after dual human approval
Ingest a signed non-decisional score from an authenticated scorer workload
post.description: Human identities are rejected. The score is verified against the configured Ed25519 issuer registry and cannot itself authorize an action.

201.description: Human approval bound to exact target

post.summary: Open a governed multi-domain investigation case

get.summary: Read all completed non-decisional investigation dossiers for a case

post.summary: Grant purpose-, case-, subject-, actor-, field-, provider-, and time-bounded access
Revoke a sensitive investigation-data access grant
Ingest an evidence-backed bitemporal person or company profile
Find non-decisional identity-resolution candidates under an active case grant
post.description: Returns evidence-linked candidates, explicit conflicts, limitations, and review requirements. It never declares an identity match or merges subjects.

get.summary: List declared non-runnable investigation source packs
Read one declared non-runnable investigation source pack
Read truthful admitted coverage for one source pack
Replay bounded authorized job events as SSE; reconnect with afterSequence
Read the cited, non-decisional result under the job's original access grant
Read ordered non-decisional job events under the job's original access grant

post.summary: Verify one signed Risk Clearing evidence envelope against live Risk state
post.description: Authenticated local Tempera Risk API-key callers must be a configured Clearing service account with the explicit clearing_evidence.verify permission. A successful response is non-authorizing: Clearing must still perform its own final admission and atomic commit. Until RiskClearingEvidenceAuthority is provisioned for the tenant/project, the route fails closed with 503.

200.description: Cryptographic and live-reservation verification result; never execution authority

post.summary: Release a reservation only when Clearing proved no external dispatch occurred
Hold budget capacity after an ambiguous provider dispatch
Record an independently observed provider effect while retaining capacity
Record a non-final observed outcome without releasing capacity
Record compensation as a forward action without releasing capacity
Keep capacity held when authoritative evidence conflicts
Settle a mature reconciled outcome and release held capacity

200.description: The committed OpenAPI contract this service serves.

post.summary: Ingest one provider-owned payment observation as a trusted event
post.description: Service-account only. Provider payment facts are normalized into an ordinary persisted event under the Risk-owned payments.* namespace, which ordinary callers may not set.

schema.description: A tempera.payment-fraud-observation/v1 body; raw cardholder fields are rejected.

201.description: The observation was persisted as a new event.

200.description: An identical observation was already persisted.
